subject: english
title: Read it aloud
parent_tip: Let your child read the story aloud while you time it. Help with a hard word, then let them go on. Read the questions together.

items.title: The Robin
items.text: Mia sees a robin in the tree. The robin has a red chest. It sings a happy song. Mia sits very still and quiet. She wants to listen. The robin flies down to the grass. It finds a worm to eat. Then it flies back to its nest.

items.q: What does the robin find to eat?
